start: Member page of a member with no plan; the gym has at least one plan on sale

steps.action: Tap 'Sell membership'
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Sell membership'
'For <member name>'
'Plan' list, each line '<plan name> — <price>'
'Starts on' set to today
'Valid till' with the last day and 'Last day they can train. The next plan can start <next day>.'
must_not: The sheet titled Renew for a member who never had a plan
A start day before today chosen by itself

steps.action: Leave Plan price and Joining fee blank
user_sees: Hint 'Leave blank for the plan price. Type a lower number to give a discount.'
Joining fee hint 'Charged once, on joining.'
'Total to pay' = plan price + joining fee
must_not: Total shown as a dash or zero when both boxes are blank
Joining fee left out of the total for a first-time member

steps.action: Type the whole total in 'Received now', keep 'Paid by' on Cash
user_sees: 'Received on' appears, set to today
No 'Still due after this' line
must_not: Paid by starting on UPI
A dues line shown when the whole total is received

steps.action: Type a note, tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: Button reads 'Saving…' and cannot be pressed
Sheet closes
Message 'Membership saved. Receipt <number>.'
The member page shows the plan with its dates and one receipt
must_not: Two memberships or two receipts
A membership saved without its receipt
The receipt without the name of the person who took the money

start: Enquiries, a 'Become a member' request that picked a plan and a start day; the person was just added as a member

steps.action: Finish adding the member from the enquiry
user_sees: Sheet 'Sell membership' opens by itself on the plan they picked
'Starts on' is the day they picked, if it is today or later
must_not: The first plan of the list shown instead of the picked plan while that plan is on sale
A picked day in the past used as the start

steps.action: Type the money received, tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: Sheet closes and the enquiry flow closes
The member shows the new plan
must_not: The enquiry left open as not joined
A second member row for the same person

start: Member page, section with 'No memberships yet'

steps.action: Tap 'Sell membership' inside the empty box ('Sell one. Then they show in the renewals list when their plan is ending.')
user_sees: The same 'Sell membership' sheet as from the top button
must_not: A different form or different defaults from the top button

start: Sell membership sheet open for a member with no plan

steps.action: Type '1,2,3,4' in Plan price, tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: Under Plan price: 'The price looks wrong. Type it again.'
Sheet stays open
must_not: The sale saved at ₹123.40 or any guessed price

steps.action: Clear the price; type more than the total in 'Received now', tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: 'Amount received is more than the total.'
must_not: A receipt bigger than the sale
A minus due

steps.action: Fix the amount; set 'Received on' to tomorrow, tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: 'The payment date can’t be in the future.'
must_not: A receipt dated ahead of today

steps.action: Set 'Received on' to today, tap 'Confirm' with the internet off and no offline setup done
user_sees: A plain message at the top of the sheet, or the sale kept on this device with words that say so
must_not: A 'saved' message for a sale that was not kept anywhere
A second sale when Confirm is pressed again after the internet returns

start: Member with one plan that was sold a minute ago by mistake and then cancelled, nothing paid

steps.action: Tap 'Sell membership' again
user_sees: Sheet 'Sell membership' (not Renew), starting today
Joining fee placeholder shows the plan's joining fee and 'Charged once, on joining.'
must_not: The joining fee dropped to zero because of the cancelled, unpaid plan
A start pushed after the cancelled plan's end

steps.action: Save the right plan with money received; reopen the sheet
user_sees: Now titled 'Renew membership'
'Starts on' is the day after the new plan ends, with the hint 'The day after their current plan ends (<day>).'
Joining fee hint 'Already paid a joining fee before, so it is not charged again.'
must_not: A second joining fee as the default
A start inside the plan just sold

start: A sale just saved with a note and money received

steps.action: Open the member page and the receipt
user_sees: The receipt and the plan show who took the money (the signed-in person)
The note is shown to the gym only
must_not: The receipt with no taker name
The note shown to the member in the member app
The sale visible to a login of another gym or another branch

steps.action: As owner, open Money, Collections
user_sees: The receipt in today's list with the taker's name
must_not: The receipt missing from the totals of the day in Received on
